excerpt.zh: 行商联盟欢迎您光临绰尔的罗盘，这里是星际行商的起源地。您没有听错。
excerpt.en: The Caravansary Caravan Coalition welcomes you to Chor's Compass, ancestral home of disparate galactic caravans and gambling. You heard that right.

scope.zh: 主菜单与三个子菜单、敌对时的替代窗口、AI 访问条件及价格/权重均已核对。
scope.en: The main menu and its three submenus, the hostile alternative window, the AI visit condition, prices and weights were checked.

uncertain: The way CaravanCoinz are bought (cara.150) is a parody premium-currency menu; the real-money handling, if any, is engine-side.

label.en: The three submenus of the main menu

note.zh: 玩家可以任意次序、反复进入老虎机、圣物箱和行商币菜单，每次都回到主菜单；另有三个“关于车队”的对话选项和一个结束通话选项。
note.en: The player may enter the slots, reliquary and CaravanCoinz menus in any order and repeatedly, each returning to the main menu; there are also three "about the fleet" dialog options and an end-communication option.

texts.zh: 行商联盟欢迎您光临绰尔的罗盘，这里是星际行商的起源地。您没有听错。
texts.en: The Caravansary Caravan Coalition welcomes you to Chor's Compass, ancestral home of disparate galactic caravans and gambling. You heard that right.

texts.zh: 欢迎来到贸易空间站堂吉，这里是全宇宙最顶级的休闲场所，同时也是行商舰队的家园！
texts.en: Welcome to Tradestation Tungle, the galaxy's premier leisure palace and home base of the Caravaneer fleets!

texts.zh:
根据心理档案资料显示对成瘾性活动抵抗力弱的智慧生命一般都不推荐参与老虎机和圣遗物活动。

如果他们那么不喜欢享乐的话，那就这样吧！
texts.en:
Sapients with psychological profiles particularly vulnerable to addictive activities are advised to stay away from the Slots and Reliquaries.

If they hate fun, that is!

texts.zh: 我们是绰尔的罗盘的行商联盟的范格利集团。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
texts.en: This is the Caravansary Caravan Coalition in Chor's Compass, speaking on behalf of The Vengralian Trium. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

texts.zh: 我们是绰尔的罗盘的行商联盟的拜金教团。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
texts.en: This is the Caravansary Caravan Coalition in Chor's Compass, speaking on behalf of The Numistic Order. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

texts.zh: 我们是绰尔的罗盘的行商联盟的拉奇工业公司。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
texts.en: This is the Caravansary Caravan Coalition in Chor's Compass, speaking on behalf of Racket Industrial Enterprise. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

texts.zh:
根据心理档案资料显示对成瘾性活动抵抗力弱的智慧生命一般都不推荐参与老虎机和圣遗物活动。

如果他们那么不喜欢享乐的话，那就这样吧！
texts.en:
Sapients with psychological profiles particularly vulnerable to addictive activities are advised to stay away from the Slots and Reliquaries.

If they hate fun, that is!

texts.zh: 你是会赌博的智慧生物吗？
texts.en: Are you a betting sapient?

texts.zh: 我们这买的大赚的大，当然如果你不是那种孤注一掷型选手，那我们这也提供下小注的业务。
texts.en: We offer high-stakes thrills and also low-stakes thrills, if that's more your speed.

label.zh: 我们是想联系范格利集团来着……
label.en: We were trying to reach The Vengralian Trium...

responses.zh:
所有相关的行商舰队维持着亚空间通讯发明之前的传统。而我们贸易空间站堂吉是个例外，所以所有呼叫都转移到了我们这边。

恐怕你得等[From.GetName]再次进入你们领地之后主动呼叫你。或者是在离开你们领地的时候，具体取决于你们之间的约定。

在你等待的时候，何不试试老虎机呢？
responses.en:
All affiliated caravan fleets uphold traditions predating the invention of subspace communications. We, here at Tradestation Tungle, are the exception, thus all calls are rerouted to us.

I'm afraid you'll have to wait for [From.GetName] to contact you when they enter your territory once again. Or depart it, depending on what you have agreed on.

Why not try your luck at the Slots while you wait?

label.zh: 我们是想联系拜金教团来着……
label.en: We were trying to reach The Numistic Order...

responses.zh:

I'm afraid you'll have to wait for [From.GetName] to contact you when they enter your territory once again. Or depart it, depending on what you have agreed on.

Why not try your luck at the Slots while you wait?

label.zh: 我们是想联系拉奇来着……
label.en: We were trying to reach the Rackets...

responses.zh:
他们是不是很可爱？而且还很勇猛呢！咳咳。

所有相关的行商舰队维持着亚空间通讯发明之前的传统。而我们贸易空间站堂吉是个例外，所以所有呼叫都转移到了我们这边。

responses.en:
Adorable, aren't they? Intrepid, too! Ahem.

All affiliated caravan fleets uphold traditions predating the invention of subspace communications. We, here at Tradestation Tungle, are the exception, thus all calls are rerouted to us.

I'm afraid you'll have to wait for [From.GetName] to contact you when they enter your territory once again. Or depart it, depending on what you have agreed on.

Why not try your luck at the Slots while you wait?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：玩家点击贸易站（楚尔罗盘）或某支车队的盾徽时打开；AI 只在每月检查（cara.333）中出现，需有通讯、能量储备及月收入足够，或“行商币”余额≥3000（events/caravaneer_events.txt:5639-5672）。从子菜单返回时同样回到本窗口（cara_home_return）。
notes.en: Commentary: opened when the player clicks the tradestation (Chor's Compass) or a fleet's shield; the AI only appears through the monthly check (cara.333): in communication, enough energy stock and income, or a CaravanCoinz balance of 3000+ (events/caravaneer_events.txt:5639-5672). Returning from a submenu comes back to this window (cara_home_return).

texts.zh:
这个小游戏的目标是要在滚筒停止旋转时将滚筒上的图案排列为一行。

不，你没办法完全操纵它们什么时候停止。是不是有点小兴奋想马上试试？
texts.en:
The goal is to have the symbols on the spinning reels line up, when said reels eventually stop spinning.

No, you do not have any control over the timing of it all. Isn't that exciting?

texts.zh: 理论上来说，你有很高几率大赢特赢！
texts.en: You have a statistically extant chance to win big!

texts.zh: 这些转轴是使用这个太空站上的最后一批加图兽的骨髓做成的。那些害虫可难缠了。
texts.en: The reels get their pearlescent finish from the marrow of the last Gatunems to even haunt this station. Horrid little pests.

label.zh: 我们没有足够的行商币
label.en: We do not have enough CaravanCoinz
We had something else in mind...

texts.zh: 滚筒一个接着一个停了下来，结果是……
texts.en: One after another, the reels come to a halt, and...

notes.zh: 评注：老虎机一次消耗 2783.92 行商币；结果权重 70 坏1、15 坏2、4×3 小奖、1×3 大奖（其中一项需拥有远古遗物才可出）、1 特等奖（cara.210，events 553-577）。
notes.en: Commentary: one spin costs 2783.92 CaravanCoinz; outcome weights 70 bad-1, 15 bad-2, 4x3 small wins, 1x3 big wins (one needs an ancient relic), 1 jackpot (cara.210, events 553-577).

texts.zh: 年代久远的圣遗物被放置在豪华的十字基座上。宝箱里一定存满了各种宝物。
texts.en: The ancient Reliquary rests on an opulent pedestal. It must surely be filled with untold riches.

label.zh: 我们打算买一个圣遗物。

tooltips.zh: 花费6194.21行商币购买一个圣遗物。

label.zh: 我们没有足够的行商币
label.en: We do not have enough CaravanCoinz

label.zh: 我们想用能量购买一个圣遗物。
label.en: We will buy a Reliquary using energy.

tooltips.zh: 花费[root.box_cost]£energy£能量币购买一个圣遗物。
tooltips.en: Purchase a Reliquary for [root.box_cost] £energy£ Energy Credits.

responses.zh:
这是一个很古老的故事了，但并不冗长。

最早一批行商聚在一起并且确立了[caravaneer_home_country.GetName]之后，每年经过这个贸易站的一小部分货物都会被封存起来，放入一个密封的容器里面，然后放在贸易站最底层的货舱中。这项传统从很久以前就一直流传到了现在，现在货舱被填满了。

那我们也该是时候出售这些圣遗物了。
responses.en:
It is an old story, but not a long one.

When the caravans first came together and the [caravaneer_home_country.GetName] was established, it was decreed that a small, random portion of goods passing through this station every year was to be seized, placed in hermetically sealed containers, and stored in a cargo bay on the lowest level of the station. This custom has been upheld since time immemorial, and the cargo bay recently filled up.

It is now our duty to sell these sealed Reliquaries.

responses.zh:
这个我们无法得知，只有买了的人才能知晓。

我们知道的是，这里面的东西曾经某个时候肯定有某种价值。虽然有证据表明圣遗物里面的东西有可能是疯狂掮客故意放进去用过的垃圾……
responses.en:
We are prohibited from knowing. That knowledge is for the buyer.

What we do know is that the contents were considered valuable at some point in Caravaneer history. Though there is also some evidence that the Reliquary containers may have been used for garbage disposal during the brief third reign of the Lunatic Broker...

label.en: We had something else in mind...

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现行商故乡的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the caravaneers' homeland appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

texts.zh: 好的，懂。我们明白了。你喜欢抽遗物箱！通常来说，我们会限制卖给单个客户的遗物箱数量，但是我们能够给你开个例外。从现在开始，尽享直接购买遗物箱的特权吧，只是每次所花费的能量币会略有提升。
texts.en: Okay, look. We get it. You love Reliquaries! While we generally limit the amount sold to a single customer, we can make an exception for you. From now on, enjoy the privilege of purchasing Reliquaries directly, with only a nominal increase in Energy Credits each time.

texts.zh:
圣遗物是……空的。

你尽可能压抑心中的怨念不让心中的羞恼之意浮于面部。到底是因为湿度骤增还是因为你的眼睛不受控制的湿润了？你的目光模糊了，但是空无一物的圣遗物依旧在那安然不动。

但随着一阵存在主义的黑暗吞噬过后，一切都过去了。这是什么感觉？回想起在你花费掉辛苦挣来的行商币，缓缓打开圣遗物时那种发自内心的紧张与激动……你现在充满了一种说不清道不明的骄傲与成就感。
texts.en:
The Reliquary is... empty.

Bitter disappointment claws at your insides as you struggle to maintain your composure in the face of this chance humiliation. Did humidity levels suddenly rise or are your ocular organs moistening on their own? Your vision blurs, but the emptiness of the Reliquary still stands out in sharp relief.

But as soon as an existential darkness threatens to devour you, it is swept away. What is this feeling? As you mull over the hard-earned CaravanCoinz you spent, the visceral thrill of opening the Reliquary... you are filled with an inexplicable sense of pride and accomplishment.

texts.zh: 是银河之星……！
texts.en: The Galatron...!

texts.zh: 圣遗物包含着一副远古图表，写满了早已失传的贸易路线，其中还包括了我们的首都恒星系[Root.Capital.GetStarName]！
texts.en: The Reliquary contains an ancient chart over long-dead trade routes, and it includes our capital system of [Root.Capital.GetStarName]!

texts.zh:
圣遗物里存放着一整套的制服。可惜的是，这些衣服的设计对象是某种比[Root.GetName]的物种更多肢体的生物。

不过，这些衣服的质料还是可以循环利用的。
texts.en:
The Reliquary contains a full complement of dress uniforms. Unfortunately they were designed for a species with far more limbs than is common within the [Root.GetName].

The material might still be re-purposed, however.

texts.zh:
圣遗物里有炸弹！

别担心，已经拆掉了。
texts.en:
The Reliquary contains a bomb!

It is swiftly defused.

texts.zh: 圣遗物装着一篇关于爱与万物自然循环的论文。它由[Root.GetAdj]语言写成，而且文风十分现代。
texts.en: The Reliquary contains a treatise on love, and the cyclical nature of all things. It is written in the [Root.GetAdj] language and the style is contemporary.

texts.zh: 圣遗物里存放着一把未知来历的枪械，其发射扳机明显已被破坏掉。
texts.en: The Reliquary contains a gun of unknown origin, with the apparent trigger assembly removed.

texts.zh: 圣遗物装着满满的军粮。虽然上面的所有标记都已经磨损殆尽了，但是里面的东西看起来尚且安全，而且适合[Root.GetAdj]的生理结构。
texts.en: The Reliquary contains a shipment of military rations. All markings on the packaging have worn off, but the contents appear safe and compatible with [Root.GetAdj] biology.

texts.zh:
圣遗物里面放着音乐，虽然这盒子里并没有任何显而易见的类似播放器的东西。

圣遗物马上被关上，并且被遗忘在某个角落里面
texts.en:
The Reliquary contains music, without any obvious playback mechanism.

The Reliquary is soon closed and forgotten about.

texts.zh: 圣遗物装满了美丽的蓝色大理石。
texts.en: The Reliquary is filled with beautiful blue marbles.

texts.zh:
圣遗物里面装着数不清的财富，如果你对不在场的人说起的话，没有人会相信这么巨量的财富会真实存在。

不过财务报表上的赤字正宣告着这个事实。
texts.en:
The Reliquary is filled with untold riches. Indeed, no one present at the opening is capable of accurately describing the immense wealth, if they will even acknowledge its existence at all.

But the treasury's balance sheet spells it out clearly enough.

texts.zh: 圣遗物里面装着几个外星设备，看上去没什么反应，应该是坏了的。
texts.en: The Reliquary holds a handful of alien devices, inert and seemingly broken.

texts.zh: 虽然是空的，但是这个圣遗物的内壁上到底都是各种印记。在更深处的地方追踪到了一些生物物质的踪迹。
texts.en: While empty, the inner walls of the Reliquary are pitted and scarred. Traces of biological material can be recovered from the deeper pockets.

texts.zh: 圣遗物里存放着一个只能以波频的方式存在于空灵界面的生灵。它在被发现后瞬间逃离到更高阶的位面，只在你心里留下深刻的启示与不安。
texts.en: The Reliquary holds a being that exists only as a spectrum of wavelengths in an ethereal medium. It immediately escapes to a higher domain, leaving only profound revelation and paralytic fear in its wake.

texts.zh: 圣遗物很难打开，感觉里面似乎是有一个小型的重力井阻止它打开似的。
texts.en: The Reliquary is difficult to open, as it is shut tight from within by a gravitational anomaly.

texts.zh: 圣遗物里面什么都没有。原本用于贮藏的空间被一块平滑的合金占据了，与圣遗物的内壁无缝地衔接在一起。
texts.en: The Reliquary does not contain anything. Where one would expect hollow space for storage sits instead a smooth block of metal alloy, one interior wall of the Reliquary blending seamlessly into another.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗恒星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the star's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现我们物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, our species' name appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：圣物箱一个 6194.21 行商币（或在“批量购买”状态下用能量，价格每次×1.05）。开箱抽取：1 迦拉特隆（全银河仅一件，已被持有则不出）、59 空箱、140 普通内容（14种，权重各100，唯一的“灵能统治者”特质项权重1）（events 915-977）。
notes.en: Commentary: a Reliquary costs 6194.21 CaravanCoinz (or energy once in bulk-buying mode, price x1.05 each time). The draw: 1 Galatron (only one in the galaxy; skipped if someone already holds it), 59 empty, 140 regular contents (14 kinds of weight 100, the psionic-ruler trait one only 1) (events 915-977).

texts.zh: 银河之星归你了！
texts.en: The Galatron is yours!

responses.zh:
这是银河之星，行商组织的基石。我们的先祖曾在此宣誓，组建出 行商联盟。

早先，行商联盟的发展全都仰赖银河之星的神秘力量，而随着时间的推移，这种力量逐渐消散了。
responses.en:
It is the Galatron. The cornerstone of the Caravaneers, the totem on which our forebears swore allegiance and formed the Caravansary Caravan Coalition.

The success of the early Caravansary Caravan Coalition is traditionally ascribed to the formidable power of the Galatron, though the nature of this power has been lost to time.

responses.zh:
这是银河之星！银河之星！

大概是吧。
responses.en:
It is the Galatron! It Galatrons!

Presumably.

label.en: What is it worth? Can it be sold?

responses.zh:
此物是银河之星，无价之宝也。因星系之人皆沐光辉，黄白之物不能易之。

但谨记：常言道匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪。财货不能易，然刀兵可夺之。
responses.en:
Its worth is immeasurable. No one will buy the Galatron from you, though all in the galaxy will rejoice in its light.

But be warned: tradition allows for it to be taken from the unworthy, in war.

notes.zh: 评注：抽中迦拉特隆后弹出，最后一个隐藏选项把遗物 r_galatron 加入帝国；遗物后续见 event-cara-970。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the Galatron is drawn; the last hidden option adds the relic r_galatron to the empire; see event-cara-970 for the relic.

texts.zh: 行商币是一种由行商货币委员会创造的高级货币。
texts.en: CaravanCoinz is a premium currency created by the Caravaneer Monetization Committee.

responses.zh:
行商货币委员会确保与贸易空间站堂吉之间的换兑体系，同时包括但不限于老虎机和圣遗物。

但大多数情况是指的老虎机和圣遗物。

老虎机只接受行商币，并且只能兑换圣遗物。
responses.en:
The Caravaneer Monetization Committee ensures full compatibility with the services ecosystem aboard Tradestation Tungle, including, but not limited to, the Slots and Reliquaries.

But mostly just the Slots and Reliquaries.

CaravanCoinz are only accepted at the Slots and for Reliquaries.

responses.zh: 有时候八千就足够掏空一个人了。
responses.en: Sometimes eight thousand is all one can afford.

responses.zh:
你可以用它买个圣遗物然后还有找零！

不算多，但至少算个零头。
responses.en:
That'll buy you a Reliquary and then some!

Not much, but some.

responses.zh:
胆量——与能力！只有有能力的人才有胆量来成就一番大事。

我们深深相信这一点。
responses.en:
The willingness - and ability! - to spend big is directly correlated with trustworthiness.

We trust you.

label.zh: 查看 行商币 账户
我们还没有购买任何行商币！
label.en: We haven't bought any CaravanCoinz yet!
We had something else in mind...

note.zh: 游戏里这里会显示你拥有的行商币数量。
note.en: In the game, the number of CaravanCoinz you own appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：与行商处于敌对时尝试联系的替代窗口，只有“去死”一个选项（events/caravaneer_events.txt:270-330）。
notes.en: Commentary: the alternative window when contacting the caravaneers while hostile; its only option is "Die..." (events/caravaneer_events.txt:270-330).

## 如何开始 How it starts

点击“行商联盟”贸易站（楚尔罗盘）或车队的盾徽即打开主菜单 cara.100（on_custom_diplomacy）；在敌对时改为 cara.101。AI 由每月检查 cara.333 引入。

Clicking the Caravansary Caravan Coalition tradestation (Chor's Compass) or a fleet shield opens the main menu cara.100 (on_custom_diplomacy); while hostile, cara.101 shows instead. The AI is brought in by the monthly check cara.333.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

cara.100 是一个可反复回来的菜单：老虎机（cara.200/210，用行商币抽奖，每次回到老虎机窗口）、圣物箱（cara.300 → 购买 cara.310 → 若抽到迦拉特隆则 cara.320）、行商币（cara.150，购买虚拟货币 8k/12k/26k 或查账）；以及“关于”三支车队的对话选项和结束通话。

cara.100 is a menu one returns to repeatedly: slots (cara.200/210, gamble CaravanCoinz, each result returns to the slots window), Reliquaries (cara.300 → purchase cara.310 → cara.320 if the Galatron is drawn) and CaravanCoinz (cara.150, buy 8k/12k/26k or check the account); plus dialog options "about" the three fleets and an end-communication option.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

老虎机结果与圣物箱内容均为随机（权重见评注）；迦拉特隆全银河只有一件。其他选项互相独立、可重复。

Slot results and Reliquary contents are random (weights in the notes); there is a single Galatron in the galaxy. The other options are independent and repeatable.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

主菜单正文有三种问候，另有“从舰队盾徽进入”“从子菜单返回”的变体；嗜杀帝国只有“去死”式的退出选项。

The main menu has three greeting texts plus variants for "entered from a fleet shield" and "returned from a submenu"; homicidal empires get only the "Die..." exit.
